data.name: Backrooms: The Wrong Level
data.detailed_description:
Backrooms: The Wrong Level is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Alone or with friends, you will explore the game, trying to understand where you are, what is happening and how to survive on this hellish level.

Features

- Scary atmosphere!

- 1 to 4 player co-op

- Proximity voice chat

- Immersive AI

- Game Difficulties

- Stealth

- Large & difficult map

- Primitive but challenging gameplay

Important Notes

This is not a typical Backrooms game. It doesn’t follow every detail from the online community. Instead, it offers a unique interpretation, integrating select elements in a fresh and atmospheric way.

The game includes flickering lights and audiovisual effects that may affect sensitive players.

Built using the SNK V3 system — featuring an improved main menu, enhanced lobby, online server browser, difficulty selection, player sound system (with UI feedback and AI reaction), and a dynamic visibility system based on movement, posture, and flashlight use.
